def r(x):
    # Reflect x around 0.5: this maps the input symmetrically within [0,1]
    return 1.0 - x

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # Under reflection x → 1-x, the feature moves symmetrically toward/away from center.
    # Due to circular symmetry of the decision boundary and training distribution,
    # the probability at x and 1-x should sum to a value close to 1.0 (conservation of complementary likelihoods).
    # This exploits conservation: P(y=1|x) + P(y=1|r(x)) ≈ 1 when decision boundary is symmetric.
    return abs(y_orig + y_new - 1.0) < 0.15
